title: Substring Sort
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 2 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 1 \leq N \leq 10^5; 1 \leq \lvert S_i\rvert \leq 10^5; \displaystyle\sum_{i=1}^N \lvert S_i\rvert\leq 10^5; 1 \leq Q \leq 2\times 10^5; 1 \leq x_1<x_2<\cdots<x_Q \leq \displaystyle\sum_{i=1}^N \frac{|S_i|(|S_i|+1)}{2}; N,Q,x_1,x_2,\ldots,x_Q are integers.; S_i is a string consisting of lowercase English letters.
